data.name: Blood Without a Name
data.detailed_description:
Blood Without a Name is a voice-acted dark fantasy political life simulation about inheritance, legitimacy, family cruelty, and what power does to those who survive long enough to wield it.

You are Darian Veyrath, heir to an island lordship sustained by vineyards, grain, shipping, and obligations older than the family that rules it. Darian’s inheritance is legally secure but personally precarious. His mother has been removed from the surviving record, his father controls what may be spoken, and every relative has a different idea of the man he should become.

Shape Darian from childhood into mature rule through private conversations, public decisions, investigations, political crises, and relationships that change across the years. What he notices as a child can become evidence in adulthood. What he neglects may become the institution, debt, enemy, or injustice he eventually inherits.

A careful playthrough can take approximately 20–25 hours, with substantial additional material hidden behind different relationships, appointments, political choices, and discoveries.

Grow Up Inside a Political Family

Darian begins without money, office, or command. His father rules House Veyrath. Adults decide which rooms he may enter, which records he may read, and which truths he is considered old enough to understand.

Listen while others underestimate you. Learn whom the household protects, whose labor keeps the estate functioning, and which family stories have been carefully edited.

Childhood and adolescence are not tutorials to rush through. They establish the relationships, skills, secrets, economic conditions, and political expectations that shape Darian’s adult life.

Become Capable Through Practice

Darian’s skills do not increase because one convenient answer awarded a point. Choices contribute gradually toward Resolve, Insight, Eloquence, Cunning, and Stewardship. Repeatedly favoring one kind of approach makes Darian better at using it, but no playthrough can master everything.

Skills unlock dialogue, letters, investigations, project discussions, political approaches, and new ways through important story gates. Players must decide not only what Darian believes, but what kind of ruler he is deliberately training himself to become.

Build Relationships That Remember

Speak privately with family members, servants, officers, clergy, merchants, workers, foreign nobles, and royal figures. Conversations react to Darian’s history, standing, relationships, and previous choices.

Affection is not obedience. Respect is not trust. Fear may produce compliance without loyalty. Major characters possess personal goals, institutional interests, private memories, and limits that shape how they respond to Darian over time.

Portrait driven conversations clearly show who is present, who is speaking, and who has fallen silent.

Inherit a Living Domain

When Darian eventually gains authority, he does not receive a convenient wallet. He inherits the House Treasury, its debts, reserves, obligations, damaged infrastructure, political commitments, and the consequences of decisions made before he could rule.

Seasonal revenue comes from vineyards, rents, harbor duties, tolls, charters, and trade. It must answer household wages, garrison upkeep, maintenance, debt service, relief, court expenses, and unexpected crises.

An estate can be wealthy while its treasury is empty. It can possess ready coin while its long term prosperity collapses.

Read the Island in Motion

The Domains screen turns the state of Veyrath into a living political record. Follow population change, prosperity, food reserves, trade, security, public approval, constituencies, household conditions, and the island’s standing within the kingdom.

These are not decorative statistics. Decisions alter their direction, and their condition changes which pressures, stories, projects, and political responses become possible.

Follow recurring households whose work, security, and expectations change across the campaign. Policy is measured not only through statistics, but through the lives required to endure it.

Shape the Estate and Explore the Region

Move between the estate and the wider island as Darian’s world expands. Visit halls, archives, chapels, vineyards, markets, villages, ports, roads, granaries, ferries, and defensive positions.

Characters appear where their work and circumstances place them. Regional conditions evolve with the season, while observations can reveal information, create small decisions, and prepare Darian for later discussions.

The interactive council map connects each holding to its population, economy, obligations, current pressures, and visible development.

Govern Through Projects, Law, and Institutions

Major projects are political commitments rather than purchases from a menu. Proposals emerge through deliberations with advisors and affected groups. Once authorized, projects proceed through visible stages, consume committed funds, and create new offices, dependencies, and disputes.

Oversee roads, granaries, defenses, waterworks, harbors, archives, settlements, and institutions. Decide who controls them, who pays for them, and who receives credit—or blame—for what follows.

Law and Custom records the orders, compacts, precedents, and royal acts that define Darian’s authority. Public Addresses allow him to explain policy, make promises, assign responsibility, and create political memory that later events can test.

Write Letters and Control the Record

Correspondence allows Darian to negotiate beyond the room. Draft letters, choose their tone, make offers, withhold information, and decide what deserves his seal.

Letters can establish alliances, request evidence, provoke rivals, reassure dependants, or create commitments that return seasons later.

News is carried by seven distinct publications, each with its own audience, interests, writers, and interpretation of events. Read local reporting, commercial intelligence, institutional records, royal news, and accounts from beyond the kingdom. The press does not provide an omniscient version of the truth. It shows how Darian’s world is being understood by people with their own loyalties.

Discover a Realm Larger Than Veyrath

House Veyrath belongs to a wider kingdom of royal authority, great provinces, banner lordships, chartered towns, religious orders, rival houses, and neighboring peoples.

The in game encyclopedia grows as Darian encounters new people, evidence, places, and histories. It contains extensive biographies, family histories, political institutions, regional cultures, maps, arcane traditions, and the contested structure of the realm.

Some knowledge is public. Some must be discovered. The most dangerous truths do not appear merely because the player opened a menu.

Your Rule Becomes the Story

Blood Without a Name follows Darian from a politically powerless childhood into the burdens of rule. It is a story about becoming powerful, then living with the systems, promises, enemies, and human consequences that power creates.

The campaign does not end when Darian receives authority. Adulthood opens wider struggles over marriage, succession, war, governance, family, legitimacy, and the future of the kingdom.

There is no single ideal Darian. He may become merciful, calculating, beloved, feared, institutionally careful, personally ruthless, or dangerously convinced that survival has proven him right.

Key Features

  • An extensively voice-acted political life simulation spanning childhood, adolescence, and adulthood

  • A progressive skill system with hidden practice, level based gates, and mutually exclusive development

  • Deep relationships built from affection, respect, trust, fear, strain, and political memory

  • Portrait driven private conversations, councils, disputes, and advisor briefings

  • A seasonal treasury with revenue, obligations, reserves, debt, and committed project funds

  • Dynamic Domains screens covering population, economy, public mood, constituencies, infrastructure, and long-term development

  • Recurring households whose circumstances change in response to policy

  • Multi stage projects with visible development and long term institutional consequences

  • Public speeches, correspondence, law, custom, negotiations, investigations, and emergency decisions

  • Seven independent publications reporting events from distinct political perspectives

  • An extensive discovery based encyclopedia of people, houses, places, governments, societies, history, and arcana

  • An explorable estate, regional holdings, and a detailed interactive map

  • Hundreds of events and multi season story chains shaped by choices, relationships, secrets, skills, and political status

  • Marriage, inheritance, family conflict, governance, revenge, and succession driven storytelling

  • Dark, painterly fantasy artwork, animated presentation, and an original atmospheric soundtrack

Blood does not give Darian a name.

Power might.

data.short_description: A voice-acted dark fantasy political life sim. Shape Darian from childhood into rule, forge relationships and skills, uncover buried history, govern a living domain, draft laws and letters, and face consequences that unfold across decades.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: none
  • Additional Notes: Controller supported. Keyboard and mouse supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: none
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1080p or higher fullscreen play.

content_descriptors.notes:
Blood Without a Name contains mature narrative themes including family cruelty, political manipulation, inheritance conflict, class tension, murder investigation, betrayal, poisoning, death, war pressure, alcohol references, and dark emotional subject matter. Violence is primarily described in text or implied through story context rather than shown graphically.

The game does not contain explicit sexual content, nudity, sexual assault, self-harm, drug abuse, or graphic gore.
